## How it was checked
- [ ] `make check` passes (or `make test` if you do not use the agent harness)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No secrets, personal addresses or hardware identifiers in the diff
- [ ] If this touches `make deploy`, the helper's allowlist or a systemd unit: described the host-side effects and how to undo them
